steps: The existing schema3 project opens with a normal static box and unchanged character motion. No-change Check produces no Apply ticket and changes no author bytes.
Explicit one-way mode rejects and retains zero margin, reviews schema4 with margin1, preserves all geometry, motion, IDs, BOM, escaped key and line endings, and Cancel discards the unsaved review.
Chinese, English and Japanese at 390px retain the same focused select and reviewed source, with reachable margin and Check/Apply/Cancel and no horizontal overflow.

Apply changes only the ordinary source draft; Save changes only the physics document. Reopen retains one-way. Disabling reviews removal while retaining schema4, and Cancel preserves the saved platform.

Real space-map offset and size buttons produce one geometry-leaf review each while preserving oneWay and character motion. Both reviews are cancelled so the runtime uses the explicitly saved original platform geometry.

Real browser plan → Godot one-way build → finite run exposes 30 validated samples. The character passes upward without platform contacts, then lands on its top with an upward normal. Existing jump/landing events drive the animation and two audio play receipts.
Instance filtering, visit/step filtering and previous/next selection operate on the same admitted records without running commands or changing actor positions.
One-way platform and character actions independently navigate to their exact /bodies/N source ranges in the same saved physics document.
Source navigation and observation filtering preserve the completed job, runtime snapshot and all author bytes after the one explicit physics Save.
